text:
Aisha (PM): quick sync — we need 6 design partners for a 6-week private beta focused on dedicated+private deployment onboarding. primary goals: recruitment velocity, feedback loop on install/runbooks, and clear success criteria for GA. who can help run outreach and screening?
Conor (Solutions): I can lead outreach. have a small list of infra-facing startups + 2 enterprise trials. will coordinate messaging.
Riley (Research): suggest a 3-question screener (stack, compliance req, expected qps) + 15min intro call. want to capture initial job-to-be-done and acceptance signals.
Jordan (Eng): we need to define min infra footprint and traffic profile for each partner. estimated minimum: 1 GPU, 2 replica pool, 500 concurrent tokens/min to validate autoscaling. Can we get customers to commit to that?
Maya (Ops): we can support 3 private installs in parallel for the first wave. need lead time for VPC peering + KMS config — ~10 business days each.
Nate (AE): I can surface partners willing to sign an NDA and provide a pilot credit. leaning enterprise customers will need SSO + audit logs.
Aisha (PM): nice. quick checklist proposal: 1) screening call 2) infra readiness confirmation 3) signed pilot agreement + NDA 4) runbook handover 5) success review at week 6. agree?
Conor (Solutions): agree. add a mid-point check at week 3 for perf/quality regressions. also propose a small incentive (waived infra fees month1) to increase commitment.
Riley (Research): for feedback loops — recommend weekly 30min sessions + a short daily async pulse channel (email/slack thread) and a shared Notion with prompts and a simple rubric. capture prompt sets for automated evals.
Jordan (Eng): pairing engineers for onboarding reduces time-to-first-query. can allocate 0.5 FTE for onboarding support across the 6 weeks. need prioritization: if a partner hits a blocker in kernel selection/quantization, we escalate to runtime team.
Maya (Ops): contingency plan: if VPC peering delayed, we can run a short-lived dedicated-hosted fallback (data controls in place) for onboarding but mark as non-GA path. need legal signoff.
Legal Bot: NDA template v2 uploaded to /legal/templates. It includes basic data handling + limited liability clause.
Aisha (PM): success criteria draft: - onboarding completed (<14 days from start) - 10k tokens processed/week after week 2 - no P0 infra bugs for 2 consecutive weeks - partner provides 8 pieces of qualitative feedback (UX/perf/cost) by week 6. comments?
Nate (AE): can we make the tokens threshold optional for enterprise partners with lower throughput? suggest a relative metric: stable production usage or signed rollout plan.
Riley (Research): +1 to combining quantitative and qualitative thresholds. add a quality gate: automated evals on partner prompt set not regressing >5% on core intent.
Jordan (Eng): operational gate: observability configured (traces + per-route latency) and cost telemetry. will provide a checklist.
Conor (Solutions): outreach timeline: week 0: identify candidates, week 1: screen + secure agreement, week 2: infra prep, week 3: onboarding start, week 3-8: beta, week 9: review & GA decision.
Maya (Ops): can we compress infra prep to 5 business days if partner is ready and we allocate an ops runbook? yes but still reserve 10 days in case of network approvals.
Aisha (PM): action items: Conor — outreach list + messaging by EOD Wed; Riley — screener + evaluation rubric by Thu; Jordan — infra footprint doc + checklist by Fri; Maya — ops runbook template + fallback plan by Fri; Nate — confirm two pilot customers and NDA readiness by next Tue.
Conor (Solutions): ack. will ping partner champions. :thumbsup:
Riley (Research): will draft rubric and include automated eval hooks (we can use the same eval harness as hosted e2e).
Jordan (Eng): will post infra checklist PR to repo and add required runbook steps.
Maya (Ops): putting a calendar block for install windows.
Nate (AE): looping in Customer X and Y today.
Aisha (PM): thanks team — let's reconvene Friday 10am to close candidates. If anyone hits a blocker, @Aisha or @Maya.
Conor (Solutions): FYI — snagged one warm lead that matches the compliance profile. sending intro now.
Legal Bot: Reminder: attach NDA reference id when sharing drafts.
Aisha (PM): perfect. small ask — try to keep partner list diverse across industry (health, finserv, infra) so we get broader signals.
Riley (Research): noted. will ensure sampling covers at least 2 industries.
Jordan (Eng): quick question — do we allow partners to opt into quantized models only? that affects kernel selection.
Aisha (PM): allow opt-in but flag as experimental. capture feedback separately.
Maya (Ops): will add a toggle to the runbook for quantized-only installs.
Nate (AE): will surface that in the pilot agreement as an opt-in checkbox.
Conor (Solutions): sending outreach note now. will paste thread when responses come in. :rocket:
